'''Eyyub Balamammad oglu Bashirov''' ({{langx|az|Eyyub Balaməmməd oğlu Bəşirov}}; December 12, 1925 – November 7, 2017) was an Azerbaijani biologist-scientist, academician, president of Association of Animal husbandry of Azerbaijan, real member of the Russian Academy of International Quality Problems and member of the board of the Council of Elders of Azerbaijan Republic.

== Biography ==
Eyyub Bashirov was born on December 12, 1925, in [[Xol Qarabucaq]] village of [[Salyan District, Azerbaijan|Salyan]] (now [[Neftchala District]]).<ref name="teleqraf">{{cite web|title=Papanın qarşısında diz çökməyib hədiyyə alan Bəşirovun maraqlı arxivi|url=https://teleqraf.com/news/toplum/119796.html|website=teleqraf.com|date=21 December 2016 |accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref> He graduated from Salyan Pedagogical Technical School in 1943 with distinctive marks and began his teaching career.<ref name="tibb"/> Eyyub Bashirov, admitted to the Zootechnic Faculty of the [[Azerbaijan State Agricultural University|Azerbaijan Agricultural Institute]] in 1945, was transferred to the third course of the Zootechnical faculty of the [[Russian State Agrarian University - Moscow Timiryazev Agricultural Academy|Moscow State Agricultural Academy]] named after [[Kliment Timiryazev|Kliment A. Timiryazev]] two years later as a distinguished student. After graduating from the academy, Eyyub returned to [[Azerbaijan]] and served in the development of [[animal husbandry]], agrarian science and folk medicine. In 1953, he graduated from the All-Union Institute of Animal Husbandry and received his scientific degree of candidate of sciences in 1954.<ref name="agro">{{cite web|title=Heyvandarlıq sahəsində dünya şöhrətli tanınmış alim-akademik, "Şərəf nişani" ordenli, fərdi təqaüdçü Eyyub Balaməmməd oğlu Bəşirovun 90 illik yubileyidir.|url=http://www.agro.gov.az/584-heyvandarliq-sahsnd-dnya-hrtl-taninmi-alm-akademk-rf-nani-ordenl-frdi-tqad-eyyub-balammmd-olu-brovun-90-llk-yubleydr.html|website=agro.gov.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref>

Eyyub Bashirov began scientific activity in mid-20th century - in 1947. In 1947–1954, he prepared works in the Moscow State Agricultural Academy and carried out scientific researches.<ref name="agro"/>

Bashirov has served in different periods in [[India]], [[Algeria]], [[Chile]], and [[Afghanistan]], in organization, development and strengthening of the agricultural sector, the breeding and fertilization system of these countries.<ref name="azertag">{{cite web|title=Akademik Eyyub Bəşirovun heyvandarlığın inkişafı istiqamətində apardığı elmi tədqiqatlar dünya miqyasında tanınır|url=https://azertag.az/xeber/Akademik_Eyyub_Besirovun_heyvandarligin_inkisafi_istiqametinde_apardigi_elmi_tedqiqatlar_dunya_miqyasinda_taninir-1020864|website=azertag.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref> In 1971, during his scientific mission to Chile, Eyyub Bashirov developed a 10-year plan-program for the solution of many scientific problems such as animal breeding development, progressive methods and technologies.<ref name="cia">{{cite web|title=3 ölkənin milli qəhrəmanı olan azərbaycanlı|url=http://www.cia.az/news-view/17393-3-olkenin-milli-qehremani-olan-azerbaycanli|website=cia.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref>

== Works ==
Eyyub Bashirov is the author of more than 700 published scientific and publicistic articles, 2 textbooks, 3 monographs, 4 instructions.<ref name="tibb">{{cite web|title=Eyyub Bəşirov – 90|url=http://tibbqazeti.az/az/sosium/867-eyyub-birov-90.html|website=tibbqazeti.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref> Among his works are:
*"Animal husbandry of Algeria";
*"Animal husbandry of Chile";
*"Afghanistan's Livestock Farming";
*"Scientific basis of problems and development of pedigree cattle breeding in Azerbaijan".<ref name="agro"/>

== Awards ==
In September 1964, Eyyub Bashirov made a scientific report at the scientific conference held in [[Trento]], [[Italy]]. His scientific report was awarded the first place and a gold medal at the V International Congress of Biologists. [[Pope Paul VI]] congratulated the sciencist for the success and presented his portrait to him.<ref name="report"/><ref name="azertag"/>
Ayyub Bashirov was also awarded with the [[order of the Badge of Honour]].

==Family==
Eyyub Bashirov was of [[Shamakhi]] origin. After the [[1859 Shamakhi earthquake|earthquake]] that took place on May 31, 1859, their families moved to the village of Xol Qarabucaq in Salyan. His great-grandfather, Hadji Samed was the veteran of the city during the earthquake.<ref name="bib">{{cite web|title=Azərbaycan və dünya aqrar elmində akademik Eyyub Bəşirov imzası|url=https://525.az/site/?name=xeberprint&kecid=1&news_id=41468|website=525.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref>

Eyyub Bashirov married his childhood sweetheart Saadet Bashirova in 1955. He was a father of three sons. His elder son, Yashar is the President of the National Karate Federation of Azerbaijan, World and European champion, Honorable Sports Master. Yashar is also a candidate of biological sciences.<ref name="report">{{cite web|title=Səkkiz dil bilən azərbaycanlı akademik vəfat edib|url=https://report.az/elm-ve-tehsil/sekkiz-dil-bilen-azerbaycanli-akademik-vefat-edib/|website=report.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref> Khanlar is a well-known dancer of the Azerbaijan Republic and Honored Artist<ref>{{cite web|title=M. Maqomayev adına Azərbaycan Dövlət Filarmoniyası işçilərinin bir qrupuna Azərbaycan Respublikasının fəxri adlarının verilməsi haqqında Azərbaycan Respublikası Prezidentinin Fərmanı|url=http://www.e-qanun.az/framework/6659|website=e-qanun.az|accessdate=22 December 2018|language=Azerbaijani}}</ref> of Azerbaijan. His last son, Khagani is a businessman.
